Embeddings request against real OpenAI API

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import EmbeddingRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"])
    req = EmbeddingRequest.from_json("{\"input\":[\"Hello world\"],\"model\":\"openai/text-embedding-3-small\"}")
    result = await client.embed(req)
    print(result.data)

asyncio.run(main())
```
